title.narrative: Inclusive access to quality education and learning

description.narrative: The 'Inclusive Access to Quality Education & Learning'project aims at empowering youth in Palestine: young people develop into active and critical citizens, ready for local and global challenges through improved education, training, guidance and access to employment. The project objectives are (1) to give youth (boys and girls), young women and men access to qualitative education and (2) to acquire STEAM and 21st century skills in a conducive learning environment.
